threads.body: `gen_ai.request.top_k` is a floating-point semantic-convention attribute (`InferenceInvocation.top_k` is `float | None`), but this assigns the raw LangChain value, which is commonly an `int` such as 40. The resulting span/log attribute is therefore emitted with the wrong value type; coerce the value to `float` before assigning it.

threads.body: This test only inspects fields on a `MagicMock` `InferenceInvocation`; it does not finish a real invocation or verify the emitted semantic-convention attributes and their types. A regression in the attribute mapping—or the `top_k` int/float mismatch—would still pass, so add a span-level assertion for `gen_ai.request.top_k` (float) and `gen_ai.request.choice.count` (int) using the real telemetry path.
